top: A ramen shop in Tokyo has a very honest warning for tourists
comment: So if you move seats, enjoy your mystery ramen. Leo and Justin, apparently, are everywhere 😭
topic_it: Cartello del ristorante Kippoushi Ramen (Fussa, Tokyo): 'se cambiate posto senza dircelo vi arriva il ramen di un altro: per noi tutti gli americani sembrano DiCaprio e Justin Bieber'
photo_it: Foto del cartello (Reddit r/KitchenConfidential, via Bored Panda)
title: Why you can't move seats in this Tokyo ramen shop #japan #travel #weird
description:
A ramen shop in Fussa, Tokyo warns customers not to switch seats, because to the staff all Americans look like DiCaprio and Justin Bieber. Photo via r/KitchenConfidential.
